title: Household doorbell
idea: Household doorbell: A residence alias and permitted contact actions replace personal details
audience: People who need to ring within a mobile surface.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic signal layout through its ring priority and explicit commitment contract: Ringing does not prove receipt or physical presence
navigation: Household doorbell keeps the current ring context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A residence alias and permitted contact actions replace personal details
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to ring; visitors contact an authorized household
composition.priority: Ringing does not prove receipt or physical presence

imagery.role: Support the actual ring context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Show permitted actions without exposing a resident list
Respect safe areas, native text scaling, keyboard intrusion and platform back behavior.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the household doorbell structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no ring content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Ringing does not prove receipt or physical presence
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized ring content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Ringing does not prove receipt or physical presence
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active ring context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure on target devices; test interrupted/resumed state and low-memory restoration.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
